description: SLEDGE is the University of Tübingen team's generative simulation software for vehicle motion planning. Its public version 0.1 provides raster-vector autoencoder training, latent diffusion training, scenario generation and simple simulation with SledgeBoard visualisation. Inputs are driving-log representations and trained model settings; outputs are synthetic driving scenes and simulated planner trajectories. The documented simple simulation uses 64-by-64-metre patches and runs the PDM-Closed planner for fifteen seconds. Source is free under Apache-2.0. A limitation is that the README still lists checkpoints, metrics and complete simulation code as unfinished; users must train and cache a model for the documented workflow. SLEDGE can construct road-transport scenarios for assessing planning behaviour. SUMO (model-sumo) is a related traffic simulator, without a tested connection here. The repository cites the ECCV 2024 paper. No driving logs, checkpoints or simulator were downloaded.
name: SLEDGE generative driving simulation
